title: Spell Shop Vortex
description: A hooded figure with a red scarf and patterned umbrella walks up a stone path toward a whimsical wooden spell shop labeled 'Locked Potions & Stars Vials'. A massive swirling blue vortex with stars dominates the night sky above the shop, surrounded by misty forest and glowing runes.
prompt: A lone figure wearing a red scarf and holding a white umbrella decorated with red runes walks up a broken stone path toward a wooden fantasy spell shop at night. The shop has a large sign reading 'Spell Shop Locked Potions & Stars Vials'. A giant swirling blue cosmic vortex filled with stars and mist fills the sky above the shop, surrounded by dark pine trees and floating glowing blue runes in a misty forest, atmospheric fantasy illustration, digital watercolor style
